note: Corps of Engineers campground on the west bank of the Neosho River just below John Redmond Dam, 3.5 miles north of Burlington off US-75 and Embankment Road. Gravel electric sites in three loops under elm, walnut and cottonwood, the southern row along the river; no camping on the riverbank or wingwall outside the sites. Reservable picnic shelter, fishing dock, playground, horseshoes and trails. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API (2026-11-06): 25 bookable electric sites (50 A on 12, 30 A on 13; water on 24), $20/$22, shelter $25, 14 nights per rolling 30, showers/flush+vault toilets/dump/water, season 05-01..09-30 (rates + calendar). Count 32 -> 25 (the 7 extra RIDB records are management sites); max_rig_ft 120 removed (it was a tent-length field); pull_through true, season, facilities, max_stay added. Waterfront lead: not waterfront -> riverview.
flags: SITE COUNT 32 -> 25: rec.gov says 'features 25 campsites'; RIDB's 33 records include 7 MANAGEMENT sites that can't be booked (staff/host) plus the shelter. The stored note's '25 of 32 sites have electric' is wrong - all 25 public sites are electric.

MAX_RIG_FT 120 removed: the 120 traces to a 'Tent' equipment length on pull-throughs 015/019. Posted RV/trailer lengths exist only on OCHA 001-006 (40-60 ft); driveways run 30-175 ft (site 007 is the short one at 30). A 23-ft motorhome fits every site.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored 'not waterfront' (note said 'no camping at the river bank'). That rec.gov line bans camping on the bank outside the sites; it doesn't keep the sites off the river. Imagery: the Neosho here is ~50-60 m wide (river, not creek), and the south row - 004, 014, 015, 017, 018, 020-025 - sits 5-25 m from the water behind a tree fringe; 020 and 021 are right at the bank with patchy open ground to the water. Filtered view, so propose 'riverview' (matches Riverside East 2128 next door, riverview). Riverfront only if the 020-022 banks are confirmed open. Tailwater below the dam - river value only, no lake value.

SEASON: written 05-01..09-30 from the single Peak rate season and the empty Oct-Apr calendar (same method as Dam Site 2127 / Riverside East 2128, whose season is 04-01..10-30). Off-season walk-in camping isn't mentioned anywhere.
